description:
Outcome: Gardener reports a broken tap, path or other plot problem (brief.md: First version must 4).
Scope: Plain-text report linked to authorized household, plot and season, confirmation and own status. Excludes: uploads and public discussion.
Acceptance: Allocated gardener saves report durably to correct allocation; forged other-plot requests denied; repeated submit safe; empty content rejected.
Behaviour: Explain no allocated plot; recoverable submit errors. Large text and plain language; phone layout, labelled controls, keyboard/focus support and explicit empty/loading/error/success states. Preserve input on failure and permit retries without duplicate writes; enforce permissions on server.
Verification: Ownership, validation, deduplication and phone reporting tests. Prerequisites: T-009. Assumptions: no attachments in V1.
title: Report a problem with own plot
